description: Ledger of SDS download failures. Each entry requires manual review before ingestion. resolver_status tracks where in the pipeline resolution failed.

failures.name: edta
failures.resolution: User decision: EDTA disodium salt (85715-60-2). Downloaded ED3SS, ingested.

failures.name: hygromycin b
failures.form_note: 1217468-11-5=Hygromycin B free base; 31282-04-9=Hygromycin B (alternate registry). Check PubChem for canonical CAS.
failures.recommended_action: Verify canonical CAS for H3274 product. May be a registry alias — check PubChem CID synonyms for 31282-04-9.
failures.resolution: State 2 (alternate_sigma_sku_same_cas) found H0654 as current catalog. Downloaded and ingested as 1217468-11-5.

failures.name: streptomycin
failures.form_note: 1217463-38-1=Streptomycin free base; 3810-74-0=Streptomycin sulfate. Sulfate is the standard lab form. Free base is unusual and less stable.
failures.recommended_action: Decide canonical form. Streptomycin sulfate (3810-74-0) is almost certainly what papers mean. Update CAS to 3810-74-0 and name to 'streptomycin sulfate'.
failures.resolution: CAS corrected to 3810-74-0 (streptomycin sulfate) in pubchem_cache. S6501 SDS matches. Ingested as 3810-74-0.

failures.name: naoh
failures.form_note: 159536-30-8=NaOH (possibly pellets/anhydrous specific registry); 1310-73-2=NaOH standard CAS. All Sigma NaOH SDSs report 1310-73-2. 159536-30-8 may be a superseded or vendor-specific registry number.
failures.recommended_action: Update CAS to 1310-73-2 (standard NaOH CAS). sigma_sid returned a non-standard CAS; 1310-73-2 is correct for all anhydrous NaOH forms.
failures.resolution: CAS corrected to 1310-73-2 (standard NaOH CAS) in pubchem_cache. 1310-73-2 was already ingested.

failures.name: gabazine
failures.resolution: User decision: gabazine hydrobromide (104104-50-9). Downloaded S106, ingested.

failures.name: dynasore
failures.form_note: SML0340 SDS URL unavailable on all brand prefixes. Likely discontinued or moved.
failures.recommended_action: Search Sigma for current Dynasore catalog. Try SML0340 via catalog page directly; alternatively check SML2340 (Dynasore hydrate).
failures.resolution: SML0340 URL was a transient 404; succeeded on retry. Ingested as 1256493-34-1.

failures.name: midazolam
failures.form_note: M2419 SDS URL 404 on all brand prefixes. Likely moved or replaced.
failures.recommended_action: Search Sigma for current midazolam catalog. M2419 may have been replaced. Check M6424 or similar.
failures.resolution: M2419 URL was a transient 404; succeeded on retry. Ingested as 59467-94-6.

failures.name: glutamate
failures.resolution: User decision: monosodium glutamate (6382-01-0). Downloaded G1501, ingested.

failures.name: qx-314
failures.resolution: User decision: QX-314 chloride (21306-56-9). Downloaded L5783, ingested.

failures.name: paraquat
failures.resolution: User decision: paraquat dichloride (75365-73-0). Downloaded 36541, ingested.

failures.name: fructose
failures.form_note: 30237-26-4=L-fructose; 57-48-7=D-fructose. Opposite enantiomers — NOT interchangeable for biological assays. D-fructose is the physiological form.
failures.recommended_action: sigma_sid returned wrong CAS. Papers almost certainly mean D-fructose (57-48-7). Update CAS to 57-48-7 and re-download F2543 SDS for D-fructose.
failures.resolution: CAS corrected to 57-48-7 (D-fructose) in pubchem_cache. F2543 SDS matches. Ingested as 57-48-7.
